I will plant maize on my whole 1.30 hectares using the seed I can afford and manage with my family. Here in Mtwara we mostly depend on the rains, and chemical fertilizer is expensive for me, so I will not use it this season. I may use some manure if I can gather enough, but I will keep the plot mostly under family labor and only hire a few people when the work is heavy.
